messages:
Evan: Quick ask — can someone run an initial perf pass for calypso-9b (dense) on the A100 pool? Need p50/p95, throughput for batch sizes 1/4/8, and GPU memory footprint. Typical seq=512, but please also do seq=1024 and 2048 long-context checks.
Priya: I can take this today. Do you want fp16 baseline first or should I try q4f16 right away?
Evan: Start with fp16 baseline so we have a stable reference, then q4f16 if it looks healthy. Prompts are in /mnt/prompts/calypso-smoke.jsonl. Also include a short warmup (50-100 iterations) and enable kv caching for the long-context runs.
Jia: @Priya model shard/config: single-shard 9B (2-socket), kv cache enabled by default. No pipeline sharding.
Priya: Got it. Kicking off smoke now. Command I'm using: ```./bench --model calypso-9b --precision fp16 --batch 1,4,8 --seq 512,1024,2048 --prompts /mnt/prompts/calypso-smoke.jsonl --warmup 80 --out /tmp/calypso_fp16.json```
perf-bot: Bench job queued on a100-22 (job id: bench-2487654321). ETA ~12m.
perf-bot: Bench started (job id: bench-2487654321).
perf-bot: Bench completed for bench-2487654321. Results uploaded: https://console.redwood.dev/runs/bench-2487654321
Marco: Quick eyeball: baseline looks reasonable — p50 ~34ms @batch1, p95 ~280ms @batch1, batch8 throughput ~450 tok/s, GPU mem ~36GB. Tagging runtime for follow-up.
Priya: Summary (fp16 run):
```
Summary (fp16):
- seq=512
  - batch=1: p50 34ms, p95 280ms, tok/s 120
  - batch=4: p50 52ms, p95 420ms, tok/s 360
  - batch=8: p50 95ms, p95 620ms, tok/s 450
- seq=2048 (tail): p95 ~1.8s
- GPU mem (peak): 36GB
Notes: stable, but p95 tail for small batches is a bit high.
```
Evan: Thanks — p95 is higher than I'd like for batch1. Can we try enabling prefix/KV cache warmup + adaptive batcher to see if tail improves?
Jia: I'll run a canary with kv-warmup=100 and batcher=adaptive on the same node config. Command: ```./bench --model calypso-9b --precision fp16 --batch 1 --seq 512 --kv-warmup 100 --batcher adaptive --out /tmp/calypso_canary.json```
perf-bot: Canary started (job id: bench-2487654788).
perf-bot: Canary finished (bench-2487654788). Upload: https://console.redwood.dev/runs/bench-2487654788
Marco: Canary summary: p95 reduced from ~280ms -> ~420ms? (wait that's worse). Actually look at full numbers: adaptive batching pushed throughput and reduced heavy tails on seq=2048, but single-request tail for batch=1 improved from 1.8s->1.2s. See uploaded run.
Priya: Extracted canary numbers: ```Canary (fp16 + kv-warmup + adaptive): batch=1 p50 30ms p95 220ms; batch=8 tok/s +12%; seq2048 p95 1.2s; mem ~36GB.```
Evan: Nice 👍. Action items: 1) run q4f16 follow-up (Priya), 2) add a runtime profile `calypso-9b: perf/kv-warm` with kv-warmup=100 + batcher=adaptive for canary rollout (Jia/Runtime), 3) PR to model_catalog recommending batch sizes and quantization options (Evan will draft, Priya to attach results).
Priya: I'll start q4f16 next and post results in this thread. ETA ~2h.
Evan: Thanks team — please ping here when q4 results are up. :thumbsup:
